dct_title_s: Eastern Archipelago : Celebes _ Southeast Coast. Tomori Gulf to Saleier (Salayar) Strait including Buton Strait and Gulf of Boni
dct_description_sm: From the latest Netherlands Government surveys.
Depths shown by soundings, relief by form lines and spot heights.
Shows depths, low water areas, reefs, peaks.
